Package index

All functions

genChangeData()
Function to impose an change impact effect
generateIC()
Function to add correlated noise to data
genOverallchangeData()
Function to impose an overall change impact effect
genRedistData()
Function to impose a re-distribution impact effect
getCorrelationMat()
Function to get the correlation for each panel defined in the data
impact.coverage()
Get the coverage for the impact coefficient
make.raster()
Function to make non-regular data into a raster
makeToyData()
Function to create a toy dataset for package testing
plot(<coverage>)
Function to plot the confidence intervals from the change parameter
plot(<diffs>)
Function to plot the output from powerSim
plot(<preds>)
Function plot the mean, lower 2.5\% and upper 97.5\% of predicted animal counts before and after the event.
plot(<sigdiff>)
Function to plot the output from powerSim
plotMean()
Plotting function to assess the mean of generated data
plotVariance()
Plotting function to assess the mean-variance relationship of generated data
powerPlot()
Function to show how the power to detect change varies with the error rate.
powerSimPll()
Function to run a power analysis for a model of type 'gamMRSea'
pval.coverage.null()
Function to estimate the coverage of the overall change impact coefficient.
pval.differences()
Function to get p-values for individual cell differences
summary(<gamMRSea.power>)
Summary function for objects of class gamMRSea.power
